hooks.command: input=$(cat); command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "protected-paths hook: jq not found — refusing edit (fail-closed)." >&2; exit 2; }; f=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$f" ] && { echo "protected-paths hook: no file_path in tool input — refusing (fail-closed)." >&2; exit 2; }; fl=$(printf '%s' "$f" | tr 'A-Z' 'a-z'); case "$fl" in */uv.lock|uv.lock|*/.streamlit/secrets.toml|.streamlit/secrets.toml) echo "Blocked: $f is protected — uv.lock changes only via uv; secrets must never be edited here." >&2; exit 2;; esac; case "$fl" in */pyproject.toml|pyproject.toml) printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.new_string // .tool_input.content // empty' | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*version[[:space:]]*=' && { echo "Blocked: hand-editing version in $f leaves uv.lock stale and fails 'uv sync --locked' in CI. Use 'uv version --bump <patch|minor|major>', which rewrites both files." >&2; exit 2; };; esac; exit 0
f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *.py) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; uv run ruff check --fix .; rc=$?; uv run ruff format .; exit $rc

f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in */.github/workflows/*.yml|*/.github/workflows/*.yaml) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; command -v actionlint >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; actionlint "$f" >&2 || exit 2
cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && uv run ty check && uv run pytest -q
